title: Land parcels

help.title: About Land parcels
help.overview: A land parcel is a cadastral plot or development land that belongs to a project. It is not a unit, floor, or edifice — it is the land you are considering, buying, or disposing of. Creating a parcel starts it as Prospect. Lifecycle status and due-diligence steps move only via row, card, and sheet actions.

sections.title: What a land parcel holds
sections.body: Create stores identity and planning facts. Stage data is recorded later in the action dialogs.
items: Project (required) — every parcel belongs to a development. Opening this page from a project already scopes the list and can prefill create.
Title (required) — how the parcel is labelled in the list, sheet, and menus.
Edifice (optional) — attach the parcel to a building in the same project when the land is tied to that asset.
Area (m²), zoning, acquisition cost, and currency — optional commercial and planning facts.
Description and attachments — narrative and files. Saving an edit does not change status.
Operational notes — available on edit only. They are not due-diligence, acquisition, or dispose notes.

sections.title: Lifecycle (status)
sections.body: Status is a machine: Prospect → Under DD → Acquired → Disposed, with a decline branch Under DD → DD failed. You cannot skip into Acquired. Actions appear only when the current status allows them, on the table row menu, the card ⋮ / right-click menu, and the sheet ⋮ menu.
items: Prospect (default on create) — candidate land. The only available action is Start due diligence.
Start due diligence — from Prospect, or Restart from DD failed. Requires a first step title and accepts optional notes and files. Sets status to Under DD and appends the first log entry.
Under DD — review in progress. Add as many named due-diligence steps as you need, then Conclude due diligence.
Add due-diligence step — only from Under DD. Requires a step title and accepts optional notes and files. Status stays Under DD. The sheet shows the full log.
Conclude due diligence — only from Under DD. One dialog: Approved (cadastral required, optional acquisition notes → Acquired) or Declined (reason required, optional notes and files → DD failed).
DD failed — diligence did not pass. Restart due diligence to return to Under DD, or Dispose to walk away without acquiring.
Acquired — you own the land. The only available action is Dispose.
Dispose — from Acquired, or from DD failed (walk away). Accepts optional dispose notes. Sets status to Disposed.
Disposed is terminal. There is no action to reopen the parcel.

sections.title: On this page
items: Add a land parcel — project and title are required. New parcels start as Prospect. Cadastral reference and due-diligence fields are not on create.
Search and filter; switch card view vs table view.
Open a card or row to edit identity, cost, zoning, operational notes, and files. Edit never changes lifecycle status, cadastral reference, due-diligence steps, or acquisition/dispose notes.
Use the ⋮ menus for Start / Restart due diligence, Add due-diligence step, Conclude due diligence, and Dispose — those are the only ways to move status or append steps.
When you arrived from a project, the list is already scoped to that project.
Delete is a soft delete and can be restored. It does not change status and does not cascade to the project or edifice.

sections.title: How it behaves
items: A parcel can exist without an edifice. Edifice is a link, not a parent tree like Floor → Unit.
Due diligence cannot be skipped. Conclude is hidden until the parcel is Under DD, and stays hidden after a decline until diligence is restarted.
Due-diligence steps are a running log (title + notes + files). Start and Add step append entries. The latest title is shown on the card and sheet overview.
Each action stores its notes on its own field (step notes, acquisition notes, dispose notes). They are not appended to operational notes.
Cadastral reference is set only when concluding as Approved.
Buildings and sellable units are created on their own pages (Projects → Edifices → Floors → Units). This page does not create inventory.

sections.title: Typical next step
items: Create the parcel with the project and a clear title.
From Prospect, Start due diligence (status required, notes optional).
From Under DD, add extra steps as needed, then Conclude as Approved (cadastral required) or Declined (reason required).
After a decline, Restart due diligence or Dispose without acquiring.
Keep using Edit for area, zoning, cost, files, and operational notes.
When owned land is no longer held, Dispose from Acquired.
Add buildings and units under the project — not here.
